GET https://any/
redirect == /tour/

GET https://any/tour/
body contains >Go 语言之旅<

GET https://any/tour/concurrency/1
code == 200
body contains >Go 语言之旅<
body contains window.tourNotFound = false

# The lesson text itself is served as JSON, not in the page.
GET https://any/tour/lesson/concurrency
body contains 是由 Go 运行时管理的轻量级线程。

# Pages that are not part of the tour are served, with a 404 status,
# as the tour UI displaying its not found page at the requested URL.
GET https://any/tour/notfound
code == 404
body contains window.tourNotFound = true

GET https://any/tour/welcome/1Patience
code == 404
body contains window.tourNotFound = true

GET https://any/tour/%C2%A0
code == 404
body contains window.tourNotFound = true

GET https://any/tour/welcome/1
code == 200
body contains window.tourNotFound = false

# No negative page numbers
GET https://any/tour/welcome/-1
code == 404
body contains window.tourNotFound = true

# The page number is way too high
GET https://any/tour/welcome/101
code == 404
body contains window.tourNotFound = true
